routing_policy.definition: Schematic stored-raster apertures; all enrolled group members. Clear: minimum detail >=0.30; smooth: minimum detail in [0.05,0.30). Both need >=96px, range>=0.10 and code-tail fractions<0.20. Engineering demonstration selected using three source-only development probes, not human recommendations.
routing_policy.category_source: source-pixel predicates over all declared group apertures, before predictions
routing_policy.group_rule: one stratum per declared dependent acquisition group

measurement_policy.definition: Schematic stored-raster apertures; all enrolled group members. Clear: minimum detail >=0.30; smooth: minimum detail in [0.05,0.30). Both need >=96px, range>=0.10 and code-tail fractions<0.20. Engineering demonstration selected using three source-only development probes, not human recommendations.
measurement_policy.routing: one simultaneous match; zero or multiple matches withhold deployment
measurement_policy.aperture: explicit integer xyxy half-open source rectangle; omission means full stored raster
measurement_policy.enrollment: all declared group members, including prospectively excluded observation cases

bias.interpretation: expected prediction-minus-reference error, not true anatomy; fitted only on development groups

scatter.meaning: development residual score-shape matrix; not perturbation repeatability or a Gaussian posterior

residual_calibration.guarantee: marginal new-group simultaneous-reference coverage under exchangeability and frozen protocol; not per-image posterior certainty
residual_calibration.missingness: failed or partially labeled calibration cases contribute +infinity, serialized as null

shared_joint_model.uncertainty_set: c + q L z, ||z||_2 <= 1, L L^T = source full16 covariance
shared_joint_model.not: not independent marginal ellipses, not new facial coordinates, not Gaussian probability

category_radii.scope: requires its containing joint model and frozen routing policy
